entries.title: Ezekiel 23:1
segments:
CHAP. XXIII. 
 
  The apostacy of Israel and Samaria from God, ver. 1-8.   Their ruin, ver. 9, 10.   The apostacy of Judah and Jerusalem from God, ver. 11-21.   Their ruin, ver. 22-35.   The joint wickedness of them both, ver. 36-44.   And their joint ruin, ver. 45-49.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:2
segments: V. 2. Two women-Judah, and Israel, two kingdoms.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:3
segments: V. 3. Whoredoms-Idolatry.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:4
segments: V. 4. Aholah-That is, his own tabernacle; for Israel falling off from the house of David, fell off from the tabernacle, or temple of God; so that all the temple they had was of their own making. The elder-Greater for number of tribes, and for power, wealth, and for multitudes of people.  Aholibah-That is, my tabernacle in her: the two tribes had the temple of God with them.  Mine-By solemn marriage-covenant.  Bare sons-Were fruitful and brought forth children to me; they increased in numbers of people; and among these, some there were that were children of God by faith, love, and obedience.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:5
segments: V. 5. Played the harlot-United in idolatry, with the Assyrians. Mine-When under my government, and protection.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:6
segments: V. 6. Horsemen-Skillful in riding, and well furnished with choice horses.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:7
segments: V. 7. With all-Other nations, with whom she had commerce.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:10
segments: V. 10. Discovered-Stript her naked, and exposed her to shame. Took her sons-Captives.  Slew her-The kingdom of Israel, under Hoshea, was by Salmanesar utterly destroyed. They-The Assyrians, had executed God's just displeasure upon her.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:15
segments: V. 15. Girded-With soldiers belts, which includes the rest of the habit of soldiers.  In dyed attire-Both rich, comely, large, and of divers colours.  Princes-Of princely aspect and majesty.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:17
segments: V. 17. Alienated-She grew weary of the Chaldeans.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:18
segments: V. 18. Discovered-Made it appear to all, far and near.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:19
segments: V. 19. By-Remembering her idolatries in Egypt, her alliance with it in days past, which she now resolved to act over again.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:20
segments: V. 20. Paramours-The nations, that were confederate with the Egyptians.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:23
segments: V. 23. Pekod-Pekod is the province between Tigris, and Lycus; in this was old Nineveh.  Shoa-Either Sia in Armenia, or the Sohia, among which were the Adiabeni, and this contained the middle part of the kingdom of Babylon. Koa-This bordered upon Media, the inhabitants were called Kohai, and dwelt about Arbela.  And all-All subjects of the Assyrian monarchy.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:24
segments: V. 24. And wheels-Lest in their march the carriage wheels should break, a store of these were provided.  An assembly-A mighty confluence of people.  I will set-Give them a power in right of conquest over their rebels, as well as mine, and I will give them a spirit of judgment to discern the greatness of this people's sins.  Judge-Condemn, and execute sentence upon thee.  According-To their will, power, wrath, and custom, against rebels; for these are their rules of judgment.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:25
segments: V. 25. I will set my jealousy-As a jealous provoked husband, I will be as much against thee as they are.  Thy residue-Either the people, who hid themselves in vaults and cellars, or what the Chaldeans cannot carry away, all this shall be devoured by fire.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:29
segments: V. 29. Take away-Deprive thee of the comfortable use of all thy labour, which they will exact of thee in captivity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:32
segments: V. 32. It-Is large, and contains what will last many years, even 'till the seventy years be expired.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:34
segments: V. 34. Thou-Shalt stagger with sorrows, that shall intoxicate, and astonish.  Suck it out-The dregs shalt thou drink, and multiply thine own sorrows.  Break the sheards-To suck out what remains. And pluck-Revenging thyself upon thyself.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:35
segments: V. 35. Bear thou-The guilt, I will impute it, the punishment, I will not pardon it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:38
segments: V. 38. In the same day-When they had newly polluted themselves with idolatry and murder, they thrust into the temple.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:39
segments: V. 39. My house-Nay, these things have been in my house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:40
segments: V. 40. Wash thyself-After the manner of harlots.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:41
segments: V. 41. Sattest-Prepared to feast them.  A stately bed-A magnificent bed, on which women sat to feast, when men leaned on their sides. Incense-Offered to their idols.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:42
segments: V. 42. A voice-A shout for joy, that there was a treaty of peace between the Jews, and the Chaldeans.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:45
segments: V. 45. Righteous men-Men that keep the law of their God.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:46
segments: V. 46. Upon them-Against the Jews, the children of this Aholibah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:47
segments: V. 47. The company-The Babylonian army.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:48
segments: V. 48. Lewdness-Idolatry.  And indeed we do not read of any after their return out of this captivity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:49
segments: V. 49. They-The Babylonians.  The sins-The guilt of worshipping idols; and you shall bear the punishment of idolaters.
